ikowien offers handrolls and we absolutely love them! 

🤩 These dishes are a new IKO signature and a specialty from Japan. They are considered the modern art of sushi, are handmade and served open.

The handrolls consist of crispy nori, sushi rice and the finest toppings. We tried their own versions with tuna, wagyu tartar, salmon and shrimp tempura! They are also available with smashed avocado and Japanese sweet shrimp, so really exquisite options to choose from. 

🍣 Besides the handrolls, IKO is top as always and definitely one of our favorite sushi spots in Vienna.🥢 

Send this to your sushi buddy! 🤭 

📍 Wipplingerstraße 6-8, 1010 Vienna

🍰 طرز تهیه تیرامیسو | Tiramisu Zubereitung

🇦🇫 مواد لازم تیرامیسو در گلاس (۴ تا ۶ نفر)
۲۵۰ گرم ماسکارپونه
۲۰۰ میلی‌لیتر خامه (شلاگ اوبر)
۶۰ گرم شکر
۱ پاکت شکر وانیلی
۲۰۰ گرم بیسکویت لیدی‌فینگر
۲۰۰ میلی‌لیتر قهوه سرد
پودر کاکائو برای تزئین

طرز تهیه:
خامه را با همزن بزن تا سفت شود.
ماسکارپونه، شکر و وانیل را مخلوط کن و خامه را آرام به آن اضافه کن.
بیسکویت‌ها را سریع داخل قهوه سرد بزن.
یک لایه بیسکویت و یک لایه کرم داخل ظرف بچین.
لایه‌ها را دوباره تکرار کن.
روی آن پودر کاکائو بپاش و حداقل ۴ ساعت در یخچال بگذار.

🇩🇪 Zutaten für Tiramisu im Glas (4–6 Personen)
250 g Mascarpone
200 ml Schlagobers
60 g Zucker
1 Päckchen Vanillezucker
200 g Biskotten
200 ml kalter Kaffee
Kakaopulver zum Bestäuben

Zubereitung:
Schlagobers steif schlagen.
Mascarpone, Zucker und Vanillezucker verrühren. Das Schlagobers vorsichtig unterheben.
Biskotten kurz in kalten Kaffee tauchen.
Eine Schicht Biskotten und eine Schicht Creme in ein Glas geben.
Die Schichten wiederholen.
Mit Kakaopulver bestäuben und mindestens 4 Stunden kühl stellen.

What if your next dinner wasn't just a dinner, but an unforgettable journey into a magical world?

Welcome to WonderWorld Vienna, an extraordinary themed dining destination where fantasy, creativity, gastronomy and spectacular interior design come together.

Located in Vienna, WonderWorld invites visitors to escape everyday life and discover an immersive atmosphere filled with fascinating decorations, mysterious lighting, imaginative details and enchanting surroundings.

🍽️ MORE THAN JUST A RESTAURANT

Forget ordinary dining experiences. Here, the atmosphere is part of the adventure. Enjoy specially designed multi-course menus, creative presentations and a selection of imaginative cocktails inspired by a fantasy universe.

Whether you choose a meat, vegetarian or vegan menu, there is something for different tastes.

🪄 A WORLD OF DETAILS

From the spectacular interior decoration to the atmospheric lighting, every corner offers something interesting to discover. It's a place where visual design and dining come together to create an experience that feels different from the traditional Vienna restaurant scene.

❤️ PERFECT FOR SPECIAL OCCASIONS

Looking for a unique date-night destination? Planning a birthday celebration? Or simply want to explore something new in Vienna?
